intro: Tuesday brings shorter-lived developer credentials, a revised workflow deadline and downloadable diffusion models. Vancouver’s new mayor takes office as Canadian factories report contraction; November planning includes funk, flamenco, practical coding talks and a theatre-linked menu.

stories.title: GitHub Desktop introduces shorter-lived credentials
stories.summary: Eligible accounts signing into GitHub Desktop 3.6.10 or later can receive automatically refreshing authentication tokens. The gradual rollout reduces a leaked token’s useful lifetime; upgrading alone does not migrate existing sessions, because new tokens are issued during sign-in.

stories.title: Public workflow restriction moves to December 2
stories.summary: GitHub postponed default blocking of public-repository pull_request_target events until December 2. Maintainers should review evaluate-mode results before temporary enforcement on November 9 and 16, then explicitly allow necessary workflows through an applicable Actions event policy.

stories.title: Security assessments expose coverage gaps
stories.summary: GitHub’s code and secret risk assessments now distinguish findings in protected and unprotected repositories. Organization administrators and security managers on Team and Enterprise Cloud can open Assessments under the Security tab to identify where coverage needs extending.

stories.title: Clover releases diffusion weights and inference code
stories.summary: DiffuSpace released Clover-35B-A3B-Preview, a diffusion mixture-of-experts language model with 35 billion total parameters and three billion active parameters. Apache-licensed weights and code support SGLang and llama.cpp, offering another downloadable option for coding and tool-use experiments.

stories.title: Pete Fry takes office as Vancouver’s 42nd mayor
stories.summary: Pete Fry was officially sworn in Monday as Vancouver’s 42nd mayor following his civic-election victory. The inauguration completes the transition from mayor-elect to mayor and begins his administration’s work at City Hall.
